rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone’s level of skill or expertise, especially in a practical or artistic field.

example.english: Their mastery of the violin is truly impressive.
example.traditional: 佢拉小提琴嘅功力真係好深厚。
example.jyutping: keoi5 laai1 siu2 tai4 kam4 ge3 gung1 lik6 zan1 hai6 hou2 sam1 hau5

rows.note: Use this when stressing how well someone has command of a subject, language, or body of knowledge.

example.english: My mastery of Cantonese is still not good enough.
example.traditional: 我對廣東話嘅掌握仲未夠好。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 gwong2 dung1 waa2 ge3 zoeng2 ak1 zung6 mei6 gau3 hou2

rows.note: Use this for a high level of attainment or expertise, especially in an academic, artistic, or literary context.

example.english: The professor’s mastery of classical literature is highly admirable.
example.traditional: 教授喺古典文學方面嘅造詣，令我哋十分佩服。
example.jyutping: gaau3 sau6 hai2 gu2 din2 man4 hok6 fong1 min6 ge3 cou3 ngai6 ling6 ngo5 dei6 sap6 fan1 pui3 fuk6
